GOOD QUESTIONS

Before we get started.

Which businesses is this for?+

UK tradespeople and small home-improvement businesses, including builders, electricians, plumbers, bathroom fitters, roofers, landscapers, driveway installers and decorators.

What does £499 cover?+

The one-off build of a fully working website. We discuss your services, photos, contact details and the structure of your website before starting, so the agreed details are clear.

When do I pay?+

50% upfront (£249.50) and 50% at delivery (£249.50).

Do I need professional photos?+

Your own clear project photos help customers see the quality of your work. Send what you have and we can discuss how to present it. The example website uses illustrative imagery, not real client projects.

Can the example be adapted to my trade?+

Yes. The fictional Oak & Stone demo shows a structure with services, project images, an about section and contact information. Its content can be adapted to your trade and business.

What about hosting, domains and ongoing changes?+

We’ll discuss what you need and agree any separate services or costs before proceeding. This page quotes the £499 website build price; it does not promise ongoing services.

How do I get started?+

Email info@road2resolve.digital or use Discuss your website. Tell us your trade, the area you cover and whether you already have a website.
